camel_example: aliyun live AddTrancodeSEI --region cn-hangzhou --Pattern keyframe --StreamName liveStream0000 --DomainName 'example.com' --Text liveSei0000 --Repeat='-1' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Delay 100 --AppName liveApp0000
description_en: Inserts Supplemental Enhancement Information (SEI) data into transcoded streams
kebab_example: aliyun live add-trancode-sei --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --app-name liveApp0000 --stream-name liveStream0000 --text liveSei0000 --pattern keyframe --repeat='-1' --delay 100 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddTrancodeSEI

parameters.help_en: The AppName of the live stream. View AppNames on the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/197397.html page
parameters.help_zh: 播流所属应用名称。您可在https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/197397.html页面查看AppName
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.help_en:
The name of the live stream.

It must be the name of the source stream. This ensures that SEI is inserted into all transcoded streams
parameters.help_zh:
播流名称。

必须为源流名称，所有的转码流都会添加上SEI信息
parameters.name: stream_name

parameters.help_en: The SEI text. Length limit: 4000 bytes
parameters.name: text

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the insertion pattern for the SEI.

keyframe: Inserts at every keyframe.

frame: Inserts at every single frame
parameters.help_zh:
追加到每一个关键帧或每一帧。取值：
keyframe：关键帧。
frame：每一帧
parameters.name: pattern

parameters.help_en: The number of times to repeat the insertion. A value of -1 means infinite repetitions
parameters.name: repeat

parameters.help_en: The delay in milliseconds before the SEI is inserted after the command is received
parameters.help_zh: 接收到命令后的延迟时间。单位： 毫秒
parameters.name: delay
